title: eval-harness: CI prompt-regression enhancements and metrics integration
author: Aditi Rao
description: Motivation: reduce silent QA regressions from prompt set changes by adding per-prompt regression thresholds and tighter CI integration with the eval metrics exporter. This PR adds a new per-prompt gating hook for our CI, wires the eval-harness metrics into the CI status checks, and improves diagnostics for flakier evals. Changes include a configurable thresholds file, a CI hook that runs per-prompt comparisons against baseline metrics, exporter updates to surface prompt-level deltas, lightweight integration tests, and documentation for maintainers. Checklist: - add per-prompt gating hook and config - export prompt-level metrics to CI - add unit + integration tests - update docs and runbook - manual validation against recent regressions Impact: Enables CI to fail fast on quality regressions for critical prompt sets while providing curated tolerances to reduce noise. Backwards compatible: existing global gating remains as fallback. See commits for details and the files_changed list for touched modules.
commits: Add per-prompt CI hook and threshold config (hooks/prompt_regression.py)
Integrate eval-metrics exporter to produce prompt-level deltas and metadata tags
Add integration test harness and CI workflow update
Docs: CI runbook and troubleshooting for prompt regression failures
